meta.title: Ownership Resale Convention Watchlist
meta.owner_decision: D-4 resolved: compare all mechanisms in declared order and let the user select; no ranking.
meta.methodology: Screening-only comparison for deed-restricted, shared-equity, and recapture ownership mechanisms. Every mechanism is evaluated against the same user-visible appreciation scenarios. Results are not ranked because the mechanisms optimize different objectives.
meta.source_verification_note: Every convention must retain a verified HTTPS source_url. Parameters marked VERIFY are shown as requiring confirmation and must not be treated as final underwriting terms.

conventions.label: Fixed simple appreciation
conventions.objective: Deed-restricted owner return that does not fall with the modeled market scenario; verify appraisal and deed limits.
conventions.source_note: Official WMRHC program page previously verified for the 3% simple annual convention. Project-specific deed terms, improvement credits, and closing-cost treatment still require administrator and counsel review.
conventions.calculation_note: Purchase price increases by the verified simple annual rate times years held.
conventions.screening_note: Default convention. Confirm deed-restriction terms, capital-improvement credits, and closing-cost treatment before underwriting.

conventions.label: Lesser of fixed cap or CPI
conventions.objective: Limits resale growth to the lesser governing rate, preserving affordability while retaining a documented owner-return formula.
conventions.source: APCHA Employee Housing Regulations program page
conventions.source_note: Official APCHA program page previously verified. The current primary regulation PDF and exact CPI/fixed-cap terms were not retrieved, so the comparison uses the entered CPI rate subject to the verified 3% screening upper bound.
conventions.rate_label: VERIFY exact APCHA cap in current regulation PDF
conventions.calculation_note: Screening computation uses the fixed leg only as a conservative upper bound; realized cap may be lower if CPI is below the cap. No CPI path is estimated.
conventions.screening_note: Verify the governing deed restriction and current APCHA regulation before relying on a rate.

conventions.label: Shared-appreciation CLT
conventions.objective: Preserves affordability in the unit by limiting the homeowner to a share of market appreciation.
conventions.source: Elevation Community Land Trust public page
conventions.source_note: Official Elevation CLT public page confirms a shared-equity model. A primary ground-lease or resale-pricing document was not retrieved, so the 25% homeowner share remains a screening input requiring verification.
conventions.share_label: 25% homeowner share - VERIFY against primary land-lease or pricing document
conventions.calculation_note: Purchase price plus homeowner share of user-supplied or historical market appreciation, plus entered selling costs.
conventions.screening_note: Elevation's public page confirms a shared-equity resale formula; the 25% share needs primary document confirmation before underwriting.

conventions.label: Fixed public-subsidy recapture
conventions.objective: Returns fixed public dollars at sale while the next buyer pays the modeled unrestricted market price and the owner retains remaining equity.
conventions.source_note: The current eCFR text for 24 CFR 92.254(a)(5)(ii) was reviewed 2026-08-20. It permits recapture of direct HOME homebuyer assistance subject to net-proceeds limits, but requires resale when HOME assistance is used only for development subsidy. The $90,000 amount is a screening default, not a regulatory amount; verify the participating jurisdiction's HUD-approved consolidated-plan terms and recorded instrument.
conventions.rate_label: Fixed screening recovery amount, limited by net sale proceeds
conventions.calculation_note: The next buyer pays the modeled unrestricted market value. Public recovery is the lesser of the entered recapture amount and net proceeds after superior debt and selling costs.
conventions.screening_note: Recapture preserves public dollars rather than keeping the unit price-restricted. Verify the participating jurisdiction's approved recapture method, affordability period, lien priority, and net-proceeds rule.

legal_gates.reason: Unavailable for HOME development subsidy — 24 CFR 92.254(a)(5)(ii)(A)(5) requires the resale option when HOME assistance is used only for development subsidy.
